title: The Morning the U.S. Bombed a School in Iran
author: Jeremy Scahill
content:
In the opening hours of the war against Iran, on February 28, 2026, the U.S.
military fired Tomahawk cruise missiles directly at a school in the southern
city of Minab. At least 156 people were killed that morning at Shajareh
Tayyebeh school--120 of them were children and 26 were teachers. It will go
down in history as one of the gravest war crimes committed by the U.S.
government since Vietnam.

Drop Site News conducted a two-month investigation into the strike, speaking
with survivors, first responders, parents, doctors, teachers, psychologists,
and other witnesses. Some of them had never before shared their experiences of
that day. This is their story.
